'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Jeremy Gardner DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Gardner]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements|VB1-D-imperialentanglements-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
